message.content:
Elena turns into a **vampire in Season 4, Episode 1, “Growing Pains”** of *The Vampire Diaries*.[1][4]

She is already dying at the end of Season 3 with vampire blood in her system, and her transition is then completed in the Season 4 premiere when she feeds on human blood.[1][2][4]

If you want, I can also tell you **when she becomes human again**.
